data.body: Final review and land evidence: Gerrit change 1681 patchset 3 passed LLM-Review +1 with no findings and Verified +1 via CI run 31643225915. Gerrit submitted the change as 058ddd16054b47dae5da2fe4b1e818b8cd0ba3d7; origin/main now contains that exact commit. The patchset-2 failure was the recorded main-branch complexity regression, not this story, and the exact lock passed after the upstream extraction landed. Residual-gap sweep: CLI is proven through the real `rebar explain plan` subprocess; library facade is proven through public `explain_guide`; the packaged pin is proven by guide parity. MCP/API, automated callers, and dual-direction operations do not expose guide rendering and are accepted as out of scope. This read-only documentation behavior has no state, recovery, contention, or destructive-cleanup mechanism. All Gerrit advisories were fixed in scope; no held-out exclusions, escalation compromises, or deferred advisories remain.
